selection_basis: Public primary safety assessments, relevance to leave-on facial skincare, and unambiguous molecular identity. Membership fixed before new comparator predictions were inspected.
purpose: Contextual ingredient benchmarks; not a validated negative-control set, efficacy-matched trial, or calibration dataset.
product_assumption: Provisional non-spray leave-on facial skincare; glabridin concentration, formulation and exposure remain unknown.
concentration_note: Source concentrations are assessment/use contexts, not model inputs, recommended formulations, or glabridin limits. EU provisions are contextual evidence, not a China compliance determination.
selection_rules: Retain every preselected reference regardless of its prediction.
Compare scores only within the same model and endpoint; do not average platforms or endpoints.
No global non-toxic label is assigned to any reference; endpoint-specific experimental findings and use conditions must be retained.
Reference ranks cannot establish a low-risk threshold or a safe glabridin concentration.
No independent validation is claimed for compounds overlapping model training/test data; unknown training membership is reported as unknown.

references.name: Alpha-arbutin
references.rationale: Skin-lightening ingredient with a concentration- and product-specific SCCS assessment.
references.evidence_summary_zh: SCCS 支持面霜不超过 2%、身体乳不超过 0.5% 的指定用途；需控制氢醌痕量。

concentration_contexts.basis: SCCS assessment and EU Annex III restriction
SCCS assessment and EU Annex III restriction; outside current facial scenario

qualifications: Hydroquinone must be as low as possible and no higher than unavoidable trace levels.
No universal 1 ppm acceptance limit is inferred from this source.
Alpha and beta stereochemistry must remain distinct; identical model predictions do not prove biological equivalence.

references.name: Niacinamide
references.rationale: Skin-conditioning ingredient with human tolerability evidence and a primary pigmentation study using a different mechanism.
references.evidence_summary_zh: CIR 2005 支持所评估的化妆品用法；报告包含最高 5% 的人体刺激性试验。2% 和 5% 的色素研究提供用途参照，均不是通用安全上限。

concentration_contexts.basis: historical highest reported use; not a legal maximum
study concentration; not a universal safety limit

concentration_contexts.product: niacinamide plus sunscreen in pigmentation study
concentration_contexts.basis: primary clinical study; not an efficacy-matched comparison with glabridin

qualifications: 2005 assessment is historical evidence; no claim that it is a newly issued 2026 review.
Do not extrapolate assessed concentrations to 10-20% products.
Some tested formulations had slight ocular irritation; do not assign an all-endpoint negative label.
Niacinamide is not niacin; retain CAS 98-92-0.

references.name: Ascorbyl glucoside
references.rationale: Vitamin C derivative with a CIR assessment covering antioxidant and skin-conditioning cosmetic uses; complementary to the primary pigment references.
references.evidence_summary_zh: CIR 支持报告所述用法和浓度；非喷雾面颈产品报告用量最高 5%。该评估未覆盖以皮肤脱色为目的的使用。

concentration_contexts.basis: maximum reported use in CIR assessment, not a regulatory limit

qualifications: The CIR panel explicitly did not assess skin-bleaching use; do not present this as approval of a depigmenting claim.
This is Ascorbyl Glucoside, not free ascorbic acid or Sodium Ascorbyl Glucoside.
Reported use concentration is not an experimentally determined universal no-effect threshold.

references.name: Kojic acid
references.rationale: Same-purpose skin-lightening reference with an explicit safety assessment and restricted use conditions; retained even if hazard predictions are unfavorable.
references.evidence_summary_zh: SCCS 最终意见支持不超过 1% 的指定美白用途；EU 2024/996 限面部和手部产品。皮肤屏障受损或去角质场景需额外关注。

concentration_contexts.basis: EU Annex III restriction; SCCS topical safety assessment

qualifications: Not a universal non-sensitizing or non-genotoxic negative control.
Weakened skin barrier in peeling products may increase absorption.
Kojic acid esters/derivatives were not covered by the SCCS opinion.
Use the final corrected 2022 opinion, not the superseded unfavorable 2021 preliminary conclusion.

references.name: Beta-arbutin
references.rationale: Separate SCCS-assessed ingredient that extends the arbutin comparison and reveals whether structure representations distinguish stereoisomers.
references.evidence_summary_zh: SCCS 支持面霜不超过 7% 的指定用途，并要求控制氢醌痕量；不能把 α/β 两者当作独立安全证据票数。

concentration_contexts.basis: SCCS assessment and EU Annex III restriction

qualifications: Hydroquinone must be as low as possible and no higher than unavoidable trace levels.
Not independent chemical-family coverage relative to alpha-arbutin.
Identical connectivity is not identical stereochemistry or interchangeable formulation evidence.
